summary: Static site on its own apex domain (e.g. example.com), not a subdomain.
description: Static site on its own apex/root domain — the domain itself (e.g. example.com), not a subdomain of it. Same provisioning as the 'static' template (git-pulled folder + Caddy); this variant only changes network:proxy defaults so the domain gets its own TLS certificate.

fieldHelp.static.repo: Git repository URL to pull this site's content from (public, must end in .git, e.g. https://codeberg.org/user/repo.git)
fieldHelp.proxyDomain: The apex domain this site will own (e.g. example.com) — not a subdomain
